template.name: Custom Header
template.script: document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { /* === SEARCH === */ var trigger = document.getElementById('exo-search-trigger'); var bar = document.getElementById('exo-search-bar'); var input = document.getElementById('exo-search-input'); var close = document.getElementById('exo-search-close'); if (trigger && bar) { trigger.addEventListener('click', function () { bar.classList.toggle('exo-search-open'); if (bar.classList.contains('exo-search-open')) { setTimeout(function () { if (input) input.focus(); }, 150); } }); if (close) { close.addEventListener('click', function () { bar.classList.remove('exo-search-open'); }); } /* Ferme avec Echap */ document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') bar.classList.remove('exo-search-open'); }); /* Ferme si clic hors de la barre */ document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!bar.contains(e.target) && e.target !== trigger && !trigger.contains(e.target)) { bar.classList.remove('exo-search-open'); } }); } /* === PROFIL DROPDOWN === */ var profileDropdown = document.querySelector('.exo-profile-dropdown'); if (profileDropdown) { var profileTimeout; profileDropdown.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { clearTimeout(profileTimeout); profileDropdown.classList.add('active'); }); profileDropdown.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { profileTimeout = setTimeout(function () { profileDropdown.classList.remove('active'); }, 300); }); } });
